title: LIST continue tokens must stay on the path (search vs store) they started on
answers: Why did paging through a LIST result in a 400 error partway through?
How do I know if a continue token came from search or a store scan?
Can I change routing gates for LIST without breaking in-flight pagination?
body: A continue token encodes position differently per backend: search tokens carry sort values (SearchAfter/SearchBefore), store-scan tokens carry a Name, and SQL-backend tokens carry a row offset this type never decodes (so they look empty). tokenFromOtherListPath classifies a token as search-originated only if it has SearchAfter/SearchBefore — anything else (including the undecoded SQL offset token) counts as a store token. shouldUseSearchForList checks req.NextPageToken with this helper and forces the store path if the token didn't come from search, so a client mid-pagination never gets rejected or silently restarted when a routing gate changes. A search token arriving where the store path would be chosen still returns 400 (acceptable: only happens on rollback, client retries with a fresh list).
applies: pkg/storage/unified/resource — LIST pagination across search/store/SQL backends
